question: During the October 2016 plug and abandonment campaign, in what order did the rig move between wells while cutting and pulling production risers, from the 15/9-F-15-D report on 2016-10-19 to the 15/9-F-1-C report on 2016-10-22?
answer: The rig started at F-15-D (riser cut and pulled, then skidded to F-14 per the 2016-10-19 report). The F-15-D forecast then planned to cut and pull the riser on F-14, skid to F-12 and pull the riser there. The 2016-10-21 F-12 report shows the riser cut and pulled and the rig skidded to F-11 B. The F-11 B riser was pulled on 2016-10-21 (the activities run from 00:00 to 03:30 that day). The F-12 forecast then planned to skid to F-1 C. The 2016-10-22 F-1 C report shows the rig skidded to F-1 C and the riser cut and pulled, with preparations to skid to F-7. The F-1 C forecast then planned to skid to F-7, pull the riser there, and skid to F-9 A. Order: F-15-D, F-14, F-12, F-11 B, F-1 C, then planned F-7 and F-9 A. The F-14 pull is only planned in the evidence, with no F-14 report included.
rationale: Sequence is assembled from the summaries and forecasts of the F-15-D, F-12, F-11 B and F-1 C reports; F-14 and the F-7 and F-9 A moves are forecast only.
